verses.text: LORD, you are the God who punishes. God who punishes, shine out!
Rise up, judge of the earth. Pay back proud people what they deserve.
LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked celebrate?
They pour out proud words. All evil people boast.
They crush your people, LORD. They hurt the people who belong to you.
They kill widows and foreigners. They murder children who have no father.
They say, "The LORD does not see. The God of Jacob does not notice."
Think about it, you senseless people! You fools, when will you become wise?
The one who made the ear, can't he hear? The one who formed the eye, can't he see?
The one who corrects the nations, won't he punish? The one who teaches people knows everything.
The LORD knows people's thoughts. He knows they are only a breath.
Happy is the person you correct, LORD, the one you teach from your law.
You give him rest from times of trouble, until a pit is dug to catch the wicked.
The LORD will not reject his people. He will not leave those who belong to him.
Judgment will again be fair, and all whose hearts are honest will follow it.
Who will stand up for me against the wicked? Who will take my side against evil people?
If the LORD had not helped me, I would soon have gone to the silent grave.
When I said, "My foot is slipping!" your faithful love, LORD, held me up.
When I was full of worries, your comfort brought me joy.
Can rulers who are evil be your partners, rulers who use the law to cause trouble?
They join together against good people and sentence innocent people to death.
But the LORD has been my high tower. My God is the rock where I find safety.
He will pay them back for their sins and destroy them for their evil. The LORD our God will destroy them.
